In Greek mythology, when Cadmus killed a dragon guarding a sacred spring near the future site of Thebes, to which Olympian god did that serpentine creature belong?
questions.explanation: Cadmus slew a dragon sacred to Ares that guarded a spring near where he would found Thebes. As penance, Cadmus was forced to serve Ares for eight years, after which Athena instructed him to sow the dragon's teeth into the ground, giving rise to the Spartoi — fierce warriors who sprang up from the earth.
